bounded_weighted_diagram_audit.scope: pinned CoxIter ordinary corpus and its separate reflection-doubling archive only

known_full_reflection_chamber.completeness_argument: The standard Vinberg enumeration produces 14 fundamental roots. The pinned Scharlau--Kirschmer record for the explicitly isometric class-number-one lattice states that the fundamental domain of W(M) has exactly 14 facets; its entire finite-face vector and five cusps also agree. Hence no fundamental root remains unenumerated.
known_full_reflection_chamber.primitive_root_norm_exhaustion: M is even with discriminant exponent two. For a primitive reflection root r, div(r) divides two and -r^2 divides 2*div(r); hence the only possible negative squares are -2 and -4, both enumerated.

lineage_decision.novelty_boundary: the positive divisor-lattice extraction and possibly the literal index-2016 27-wall subgroup chamber

solomon_index.inclusion: W_27 < W(M), because every candidate mirror is an integral root reflection of M
solomon_index.method: complete Solomon sum over every finite special subgroup

unique_reflection_stable_integral_overla.basis_description_one_based: replace e6 by (e5+e6)/2 and e11 by (e9+e11)/2

discriminant_exhaustion.exhaustion_argument: For every self-integral discriminant coset x, close its orbit under all 27 reflections additively. An invariant integral overlattice containing x must contain this closure. Only x=0 or the three nonzero elements of the displayed order-four subgroup have integral closure; hence the trivial and displayed subgroups are the only invariant integral subgroups.
